This dataset contains the eleven (11) scans of Captain McKenna's Cabin. All data was collected by the Capture2Preserv team. There are six (6) exterior scans collected with the Z+F 5010X scanner on July 11th, 2018. There are five (5) interior scans collected with the Leica BLK 360 on July 8th, 2019. The exterior scans were registered in Laser Control V. 8.9 and then exported to AutoDesk ReCap V. 6.1 to be registered with the interior scans. All the interior scans were registered and processed with AutoDesk ReCap V.6.1.
